text: Question three. A sixty-two-year-old man has had crushing central chest pain for forty minutes. Which artery is most likely blocked?
A, the left anterior descending. B, the right coronary. C, the circumflex. D, the left main stem.
The left anterior descending supplies most of the front of the heart, so a block there gives the widest anterior changes.
Question four. Which murmur is loudest at the apex and carries to the axilla?
A pansystolic murmur at the apex that carries to the axilla is mitral regurgitation. Aortic stenosis is ejection systolic, and goes to the carotids.
Take a history from this patient.
It started this morning. The pain's terrible, right across my chest, and I'm really scared.
